page.overview:
What is Magizoology?

Magizoology was the study of magical creatures. Wizards and witches in this field were referred to as Magizoologists. The most famous Magizoologist was Newt Scamander, author of . There were many different sub-categories in this field, such as dragonologists, as well as specialists.

This subject was a class taught at Castelobruxo, where students were especially skilled in it.

A Magizoologist was a wizard or witch who studied magical creatures (a field known as Magizoology); though they may possibly also be referred to as "wizarding naturalists".

The Scamander family had many members that have worked as Magizoologists. One of the most famous Magizoologists was Newt Scamander. He was the author of . Early in life, Scamander developed an interest in magical creatures that was influenced by his mother's breeding of hippogriffs. Newt's grandson Rolf and his wife Luna were considered wizarding naturalists.
